protocol.title: Optimizer-state x data-stream causal bifurcation
protocol.hypothesis: The route formation/collapse volatility in Level 7.5.3.1 is controlled by inherited AdamW state, inherited stochastic data order, or their interaction rather than by endpoint weights alone.

exact_reference.training: No new training. Reuse the hash-locked Level 7.5.3.1 step300/600/1000 model checkpoints.
exact_reference.reevaluation: All exact checkpoints receive the new Level 7.5.3.2 panels.

data_stream_reset.scope: Python, CPU torch, and all CUDA RNG states are reset after source weights and optional optimizer state are loaded.

optimizer_reset.method: Fresh AdamW state over the exact source model and Probe parameters

material_effect_definition.formed_vector_changed: Any change in the registered formed/unformed state at steps300/600/1000 relative to the exact arm.
material_effect_definition.final_fate_changed: A change in whether the final full panel forms the source-specific expected L2/L3 route.
material_effect_definition.continuous_change: At least 0.15 absolute intact-query difference at one registered post-source milestone.
material_effect_definition.material_effect: Any one of formed_vector_changed, final_fate_changed, or continuous_change.

registered_outcomes.optimizer_state_primary_driver: Optimizer-only reset materially changes at least 3/4 sources while RNG-only reset changes at most 1/4.
registered_outcomes.data_stream_primary_driver: RNG-only reset materially changes at least 3/4 sources while optimizer-only reset changes at most 1/4.
registered_outcomes.optimizer_rng_interaction_primary: Each single reset changes at most 1/4 sources while the joint reset changes at least 3/4.
registered_outcomes.optimizer_and_data_stream_both_causal: Both single-reset arms materially change at least 2/4 sources.
registered_outcomes.endpoint_weight_basin_dominant: No reset arm materially changes any of the four source trajectories.
registered_outcomes.formal_integrity_failed_causal_interpret: A source, initialization, compute, panel, or hash lock fails.

protocol.scope: This is a causal mechanism diagnostic on four outcome-stratified endpoints, not an estimate of how often each driver occurs among all seeds or branches.
protocol.stop_rule: Report the fixed 2x2 bifurcation. Do not add seeds, endpoints, training steps, reset seeds, learning rates, or post-hoc intervention arms.

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Mechanism diagnosis for four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate over all Level 7.5.3.1 branches.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed 2x2 bifurcation; do not add seeds, endpoints, training steps, reset seeds, or post-hoc arms.
